Thanks for the quick upload, Elena — I received the files. I did a preliminary check and the scanned resale certificate is valid, but the legal name on the certificate is 'Texas Retail Co LLC' while the invoice and the billing entity in our contract are 'TRC Wholesale' / a DBA. Our tax team requires one of the following to release an invoice:

- a resale certificate that matches the legal entity name on the invoice, or
- an official state filing or business registration that explicitly ties the DBA to the legal entity (signed/stamped), or
- a W-9 showing the EIN that matches the entity on the resale certificate.

You included a registration PDF but it doesn't explicitly state the DBA linkage in a way that our finance team accepts for Texas filings (they want either a stamped state doc or a clear DBA affidavit). Can you confirm whether the attached texas_business_registration_TRCo_dba_statement.pdf is a state-stamped filing? If not, can you provide either:

1) the state-stamped certificate of assumed name (filed with the Texas SOS) showing 'TRC Wholesale' as the DBA of 'Texas Retail Co LLC', or
2) a signed W-9 that lists the legal name and EIN that matches the resale certificate, OR
3) an attorney-certified affidavit tying the DBA to the legal entity (rare but accepted).

If you can get us a stamped state filing or a W-9 with EIN within 48 hours we can clear the invoice hold and push payment. I've looped in Marissa from Finance and Ben from Sales for visibility.

Best,
Alex Martinez

- a signed and dated W-9 listing the EIN that matches the resale certificate legal name, OR

If you can provide one of the above, we'll clear the hold and process payment. If there are data privacy concerns about the EIN, you can send the W-9 to finance@redwood.com directly (secure attachment).
